title: General Financial Rules, 2017 (Updated through 31.01.2026)
issuer: Department of Expenditure, Ministry of Finance, Government of India
summary: Statutory rules governing public procurement of goods, works, and services for all Central Government Ministries, Departments, and Attached/Subordinate Bodies.

title: General Financial Rules, 2017 (Original Baseline)
issuer: Department of Expenditure, Ministry of Finance, Government of India
summary: Original GFR 2017 text prior to recent threshold amendments (earlier Rule 154 direct purchase limit was ₹25,000, Rule 155 committee limit was ₹2,50,000).

title: Manual for Procurement of Goods (Second Edition 2024)
issuer: Department of Expenditure, Ministry of Finance, Government of India
summary: Comprehensive procedural manual covering methods of procurement, tendering procedures, evaluation criteria, and contract management for physical goods.

title: Manual for Procurement of Non-Consultancy Services (2025)
issuer: Department of Expenditure, Ministry of Finance, Government of India
summary: Guidelines for outsourcing non-consultancy services (housekeeping, transport, physical security, equipment AMC/maintenance, IT operations).

title: Manual for Procurement of Consultancy Services (Second Edition 2025)
issuer: Department of Expenditure, Ministry of Finance, Government of India
summary: Guidelines for hiring consultants, intellectual and advisory services, custom software architecture, and QCBS / LCS selection frameworks.

title: Manual for Procurement of Works (Second Edition 2025)
issuer: Department of Expenditure, Ministry of Finance, Government of India
summary: Standards and procedures for civil, electrical, structural works, building construction, renovations, and composite works contracts.

title: Government e-Marketplace (GeM) General Terms & Conditions & Procurement Guidance
issuer: GeM SPV, Ministry of Commerce and Industry
summary: Rules for procurement through GeM: Direct purchase up to ₹25,000, L1 comparison up to ₹5,00,000, and mandatory Bidding/Reverse Auction above ₹5,00,000 under Rule 149.

title: DoE OM on Special Financial Thresholds for Scientific Research & Educational Institutions
issuer: Department of Expenditure, Ministry of Finance
summary: Office Memorandum granting special provisions under Rule 154 (up to ₹2,00,000) and Rule 155 (above ₹2,00,000 up to ₹25,00,000) strictly for qualifying scientific/research institutions and research purpose equipment.

title: Institute Purchase Manual v3.1 [SYNTHETIC / DEMONSTRATION POLICY]
issuer: Apex National Institute of Technology & Research (Demonstration Institutional Overlay)
summary: SYNTHETIC / DEMONSTRATION POLICY: Internal institutional approval matrix, project fund allocation rules, split purchase detection rules, internal ₹40,000 committee threshold, and a deliberate conflict clause (Clause 4.2).
